need: Define which mobile numbers are required in the public registration form.
candidates: Require student mobile only vs require one or both contact mobiles as well
observed_result: Owner requires the student's own mobile and makes both contact mobiles optional.
decision: student_mobile is required; contact1_mobile and contact2_mobile are optional.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if operational contact policy changes.

need: Define the minimal data kept for optional contact 1 and contact 2.
candidates: Contact mobile only vs relationship + mobile vs relationship + name + mobile
observed_result: Owner wants relationship and mobile for both contacts; names are not needed. Both mobile fields were already confirmed optional.
decision: Keep contact1_relationship + contact1_mobile and contact2_relationship + contact2_mobile; remove contact1_name/contact2_name.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if downstream/operational requirements later need contact names.

need: Decide how to handle relationship fields for optional contact 1 and contact 2.
candidates: Ask relationship conditionally vs fixed hidden constants
probe_or_evidence: Owner clarification in chat: contact 1 is always father and contact 2 is always mother.
observed_result: Relationship values are invariant; user input adds no information.
decision: Set contact1_relationship=پدر and contact2_relationship=مادر as hidden/default fixed Gravity Forms values; keep both contact mobiles optional.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if operational policy later allows different relationship types.

need: Define when the student/graduate status question is shown and when it should be derived.
candidates: Always ask vs auto-set for single-status group_code values and ask only for dual-status values
probe_or_evidence: Owner approval in chat; current Matrix2 group rules distinguish student-only and dual-status group_code values.
observed_result: Owner accepted automatic status for single-status groups and visible choice only where both statuses are valid.
decision: For single-status group_code values, set graduation_status=1 automatically and hide the question; for dual-status group_code values, show student/graduate choice and server-validate the combination.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if Matrix2 policy changes the allowed status set for a group_code.

need: Define who may access student photo and report-card uploads.
candidates: Admin + Officer only vs broader operational access
observed_result: Owner approved Admin + Officer access only and noted this area is not a current implementation priority.
decision: Limit student_photo and report_card_file visibility/access to Admin + Officer; defer detailed privacy/retention implementation until its gate becomes active.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if an operational role later has a demonstrated need for these files or privacy policy changes.

need: Decide whether father_name is mandatory in the public registration form.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if the registration identity requirements change.

need: Decide whether first_name and last_name are mandatory.
decision: first_name and last_name are both required.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if registration identity requirements change.

need: Create a Gravity Forms import scaffold implementing the confirmed public-form field contract while minimizing new dependencies and preserving current Matrix2 compatibility where evidence is direct.
candidates: Native GF fields/conditional logic + controlled static school choices + existing GF Copy Cat pattern for canonical group/status derivation.
probe_or_evidence: Owner-requested execution; historical Gravity Forms export/import shape; Master D-09 native-first selector rule; school-crosswalk.json; current Matrix2 app/infra/excel/import_to_sabt.py GF_FIELD_TO_COL mapping at SHA 24a13e9; Gravity Forms/Gravity Perks official docs.
observed_result: Generated SRWF_GravityForms_Import_v0.1.json. Local checks: valid JSON, 36 unique field IDs, all conditional/copy references resolve, 949 school choices including Other=0. Current Matrix2-consumed IDs preserved for identity/contact/group/status/school/center/finance/Hekmat fields.
decision: Use this as the staging import scaffold; do not recreate legacy mentor/alias/output-shaping fields. School selector starts with native Enhanced UI. Report-card special-school requiredness remains a bounded runtime validation gap because a single GF File Upload field cannot express conditional requiredness in import JSON alone.
reopen_condition: Reopen scaffold design only if target import fails, V-03 school search fails, or compatibility smoke test proves a specific residual dependency.
